LanguageData.Rim3D_SettingsHint: Changes apply immediately and are saved when you close settings. Additional effects control weather particles, atmospheric fog, snow, flames, shadows, camera motion and status overlays. Gameplay and weather lighting remain unchanged.
LanguageData.Rim3D_SettingsApplyHint: Changes apply immediately and are saved when you close settings.
LanguageData.Rim3D_SettingVisualEffectsHint: The master switch controls the visual effects below. Individual preferences are preserved when it is off. Heartbeat sound is controlled separately.
LanguageData.Rim3D_SettingNightBrightnessHint: 100% keeps the original darkness. Higher values brighten the 3D view at night without changing daytime lighting or gameplay.
LanguageData.Rim3D_SettingCameraBob: Camera bob, breathing and sprint FOV
LanguageData.Rim3D_SettingStatusEffects: Injury, hunger, fatigue and sleep overlays

LanguageData.Rim3D_SettingHideInterfaceHint: Hides panels, hints, crosshair, notifications and minigames, and fills the screen with the 3D view. F11 hides and restores the interface. You can also change this setting through the Escape menu.
LanguageData.Rim3D_SettingPortraitPawnSwitch: Switch pawns with Alt + click on a portrait
LanguageData.Rim3D_SettingAdditionalHudNeeds: Select additional needs for the panel
LanguageData.Rim3D_SettingPlantWindHint: Grass, bushes and trees sway with wind strength and weather. Disable to reduce GPU load.
LanguageData.Rim3D_SettingSimpleWaterHint: Disables waves and ripples and simplifies the water surface to reduce rendering cost. Preserves color, lighting and smooth shorelines. Geometry updates gradually.
LanguageData.Rim3D_SettingMaxPawnTextureResolution: Maximum pawn and animal capture resolution: {0} px
LanguageData.Rim3D_SettingMaxPawnTextureResolutionHin: Resolution follows body, clothing and other source textures. This limit caps the longest side of the capture; higher values use more video memory. Applies immediately.

LanguageData.Rim3D_SettingMountainSimplificationHint: Higher levels simplify mountains more aggressively and closer to the camera. Seams and entrances are preserved. Applies immediately.
LanguageData.Rim3D_RecreationUnavailable: This recreation is unavailable right now.
LanguageData.Rim3D_SettingLegacyTreeScaleHint: Restore the previous tree size. By default, trees are twice as large. Changes apply as map chunks refresh; no restart is required.
LanguageData.Rim3D_SettingAnimalPlantModelsHint: Click to switch. 2D uses sprites; 3D uses addon models when available, with sprites as a fallback. No restart is required.
LanguageData.Rim3D_SettingAutoGenerateBuildings: Generate 3D models for buildings without a model
LanguageData.Rim3D_SettingAutoGenerateBuildingsHint: Approximate volumes follow the texture silhouette and building properties. Floor objects and custom models keep their existing rendering. Changes apply as map chunks refresh.
LanguageData.Rim3D_MoveFurnitureHint: Left click – choose destination, [[RotateOrSwap]] – rotate, right click or Esc – cancel. Furniture stays in place until confirmed.
LanguageData.Rim3D_CompassHint: [[Compass]]: create/edit compass marker on ground under crosshair
LanguageData.Rim3D_CompassAimGround: Aim at the ground to place a compass marker.
LanguageData.Rim3D_CompassMarkerLimit: Compass marker limit reached (32). Aim near an existing marker and press [[Compass]] to edit or delete it.
LanguageData.Rim3D_SettingCompassHint: In multiplayer, disabling the compass as host hides it for all players and disables marker placement. When enabled by the host, each player can hide their own compass.
LanguageData.Rim3D_SettingShootWhileRunningHint: Disables the weapon running animation and allows firing and aiming while running. Off by default. In multiplayer, the host controls this setting for all players.
LanguageData.Rim3D_SettingLockClientPawnsHint: Multiplayer only: clients stay in 3D and cannot switch pawns. Incapacitation or death transitions to the free camera after the fall animation. The host is unrestricted.
LanguageData.Rim3D_SettingModelLodsHint: XML models use LODs generated during mod build. Distant models use game textures. Changes apply gradually by chunk. Held models and animated structures keep their original detail.
LanguageData.Rim3D_BindingsHint: Click a key, then press a keyboard key. Two keys per action. Esc cancels. Duplicate bindings may conflict.
LanguageData.Rim3D_BindingPressKey: Press a keyboard key. Esc cancels. To unbind, click below.
LanguageData.Rim3D_SettingMinigameExperienceHint: At multiplier ×1: Mining and woodcutting: +5% work per point. Snake: +5% per 5 points. Other work minigames: up to 5% and 10 game seconds of labor per point. Research: up to 10 game seconds of work per point, capped at 1% of the project and +50% of the normal rate. Disabling the bonus on the host disables it for everyone. Minigames remain local.
LanguageData.Rim3D_ResearchHint: Click to rotate nodes. Connect the source on the left to the outputs on the right. Claim 1–2 points early, or connect all three for 4 points.
LanguageData.Rim3D_ResearchReward: Per point: up to 10 game seconds of work, capped at 1% of the project. Acceleration cap: +50%; rewards wait in the queue.
LanguageData.Rim3D_WoodcuttingHint: Strike on the matching side when the mark reaches the line. Hit: +1 point; right on the line: +2. Missing does not slow normal chopping.
LanguageData.Rim3D_WoodcuttingReady: Keep the rhythm at the strike line
LanguageData.Rim3D_WoodcuttingReward: Score {0} for +{1}% chopping when the bonus is enabled.
LanguageData.Rim3D_MiningHint: Strike in the green zone. Three hits break the rock. Finish in the gold zone for double points.
LanguageData.Rim3D_MiningReward: Score {0} for +{1}% work when the bonus is enabled.
LanguageData.Rim3D_ReloadResearchJob: Restart the game to load the manual research job.
LanguageData.Rim3D_MinigameHint: Move with arrows or WASD. Score {0} to gain {1}% progress on the current work when the bonus is enabled. Closing does not interrupt work.
LanguageData.Rim3D_MinigameExperienceOff: No work progress bonus for this action
LanguageData.Rim3D_MortarHelp: [[Movement]] – pan · Wheel – zoom · [[Interact]] – center on mortar\nLMB – assign target · RMB – cancel target · Escape – return to pawn
LanguageData.Rim3D_MortarCancelled: Target cancelled; fire stopped until a new target is assigned. Shells already fired remain in flight.
LanguageData.Rim3D_MortarRangeLegend: Green – within firing area · Red – cannot fire
LanguageData.Rim3D_MortarNextAmmo: The pawn will pick this shell type next.
LanguageData.Rim3D_MortarInvalid: This cell cannot be shelled. Choose a target in the green area.
LanguageData.Rim3D_MortarNotReady: The pawn has not manned the mortar yet. Wait for arrival or reloading.
LanguageData.Rim3D_MortarOrdered: Target command sent. The pawn continues approaching and loading automatically.
LanguageData.Rim3D_MortarChooseTarget: Left-click the green area to assign a target, even before the mortar is ready.
LanguageData.Rim3D_MortarPaused: Paused – preparation and firing are suspended.
LanguageData.Rim3D_MortarHoldFire: Hold fire is enabled. The mortar will not fire.
LanguageData.Rim3D_MortarRoofed: The mortar is under a roof and cannot fire.
LanguageData.Rim3D_MortarRefueling: Maintenance: a barrel or fuel is required. The target is retained.
LanguageData.Rim3D_MortarLoading: The pawn is delivering and loading a shell. You can assign a target now.
LanguageData.Rim3D_MortarApproaching: The pawn is moving to the mortar. You can assign a target now.
LanguageData.Rim3D_MortarUnavailable: The mortar is unavailable. Hover over this status for details.
LanguageData.Rim3D_MortarCooldown: Reloading: {0} s until ready to aim.
LanguageData.Rim3D_PasteUnavailable: Paste unavailable: you need free hands, access to the dispenser, power and food in the hoppers.
LanguageData.Rim3D_ActivityBuildingHint: Fix three parts in the center of the blueprint: Space or the button. Three precise hits earn 2 points. A miss only resets this minigame section.
LanguageData.Rim3D_ActivityRepairHint: Select a faulty node, then its tool: 1 – broken wire, 2 – corrosion, 3 – short circuit. Repair three nodes. No mistakes earns 2 points.
LanguageData.Rim3D_ActivityCraftingHint: Hold LMB at point 1 and trace the line through every point. Stay on the contour. One continuous pass without mistakes earns 2 points.
LanguageData.Rim3D_ActivitySowingHint: Plant in dark holes at the line: keys 1/2/3 or the row buttons. Let gray stones pass. Four consecutive plantings earn a point.
LanguageData.Rim3D_ActivityHarvestHint: Pick four golden ripe plants. Green plants are unripe; crossed red plants are damaged. No mistakes earns 2 points.
LanguageData.Rim3D_ActivityDismantlingHint: Undo the four corner fasteners marked +. Remove both panels, then the frame. This order only affects the minigame.
LanguageData.Rim3D_ActivitySmoothingHint: Hold LMB and follow the tops of the raised areas as they lower. Level all eight areas to the green line.
LanguageData.Rim3D_ActivityBandagingHint: Hold LMB at the green start, drag the bandage straight and release in the gold zone. Lay four strips. Precise tension earns 2 points.
LanguageData.Rim3D_ActivityReady: Complete a stage to earn a bonus
LanguageData.Rim3D_ActivityReward: A stage earns 1–2 points. Each adds up to 5% work, capped at 10 game seconds of normal labor, when the bonus is enabled.
LanguageData.Rim3D_ActivityChessHint: Click the white knight N, then a square attacking both the queen Q and rook R. Knights move in an L. Solve without mistakes for 2 points, otherwise 1.
LanguageData.Rim3D_ActivityHorseshoesHint: Use Space or the button to set direction, then power. Account for wind. A ringer earns 2 points; landing near the pin earns 1.
LanguageData.Rim3D_RecreationReward: Each point: +{0}% recreation when the bonus is enabled. Normal recreation continues on its own.
LanguageData.Rim3D_SettingNeighborMaps: Generate and display eight neighboring maps
LanguageData.Rim3D_SettingNeighborMapsHint: Experimental: generates eight local maps around the current surface map as a 3×3 square. Full maps remain paused and are cached in the save; only simplified terrain, rocks and tree sprites are displayed. Initial generation takes time and increases memory and save size. Disabling hides the surroundings and stops further generation, but keeps cached maps. In Multiplayer only the host prepares maps. Travel is not available yet; map edges are not seamless.
LanguageData.Rim3D_ControlsHelpLegend: Green highlights actions available before opening help. Other actions and all key bindings are listed below. F1 or Esc closes help.
LanguageData.Rim3D_SettingMinigameLocalHint: The master minigame switch and individual game selection apply only to you. Disabled games are not replaced by Snake. Normal work continues independently.
LanguageData.Rim3D_SettingMinigameHostRewardsHint: In multiplayer, the host controls rewards and multipliers for everyone. Clients can only view these settings. ×0 gives no reward; ×1 gives the normal reward. Multipliers scale the base reward and its limits; scores and difficulty stay the same.
